question: Can you identify a children museum within 110 kilometers of Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake, Northlake, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%children museum%' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 110 * 1000 );
